A robot program failed to move "yellow_pen" (kind: pen) onto "green_case".

obs = observe()
pen = obs["objects"]["yellow_pen"]
case = obs["zones"]["green_case"]

candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
best_candidate = None
min_diff = float('inf')
for c in candidates:
    diff = abs(c["yaw"] - pen["long_axis_yaw"])
    if diff < min_diff:
        min_diff = diff
        best_candidate = c

grasp(best_candidate)
if not observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to grasp yellow_pen")

spots = free_spots("green_case", "yellow_pen")
spot = spots["spots"][0]
target_yaw = case["long_axis_yaw"]
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=target_yaw)
rotate_by(target_yaw - best_candidate["yaw"])
lower_until_contact()
open_gripper()
retreat()
check("yellow_pen", "green_case")
